sn35.136:7.4: Bodhi translates “dullards”, evidently reading _magā_ (“beasts”) and taking to mean “fools”. However, I can’t find support for this sense in Pali or Sanskrit. The commentary explains it as those inexpert in knowing what is the path and what is not the path, apparently taking _maggā_ as a truncation of _maggāmagga_. I read as a secondary derivative from _magga_ in the old sense “seeking”, with the _-a_ suffix making it the agentive “seekers”.
